title: What Influences Temperature?

activityHeadings: 4.2: Is Temperature a Function of Latitude?
4.3: Is There an Association Between Latitude and Temperature?

learningGoals: Goal: identify candidate predictors for temperature data, distinguish measurements from explanatory claims and examine how geographical and seasonal variables could confound a model.

Latitude, elevation, distance from ocean, season and time of day may influence observed temperature. A bivariate graph of latitude and temperature may show an association, but a single predictor cannot account for all geographic variation.

rubric.expectedReasoning: The model predicts 20 degrees. Season, elevation, ocean distance, and time of day can confound the relationship; association is not a complete causal explanation.
Geometric constructions distinguish gap-free/overlap-free tessellation from visual proximity, and statistical models distinguish prediction from exact observation.
